# Crazyflie 2.1 visual mesh attribution

This project uses `meshes/stl_files/cf2_assembly.stl` from the Bitcraze
`crazyflie-simulation` repository for visual rendering of each UAV.

- Source: https://github.com/bitcraze/crazyflie-simulation
- Copyright: Bitcraze, 2022
- License: MIT (`LICENSE` in this directory)

The mesh is visual-only in this project; collision and dynamics use a separate
MuJoCo primitive hull.
